LeasePostingProfile.description: Defines the main ledger accounts for all IFRS 16 / ASC 842 lease transaction types (recognition, depreciation, interest accrual, payment). This is the primary source for every lease accounting entry and should be the first place checked when investigating account mapping errors.

ROU Asset Account.description: Right-of-Use asset recognised on the balance sheet at lease commencement

Lease Liability Account.description: Present value of future lease payments — long-term liability

Depreciation Expense Account.description: Periodic amortisation / depreciation of the ROU asset charged to P&L

Accumulated Depreciation Account.description: Contra-asset accumulating total depreciation charged on the ROU asset

Interest Expense Account.description: Unwinding of the discount on the lease liability — IFRS 16 effective interest method

Interest Payable Account.description: Accrued but unpaid interest on the lease liability

LeaseBook.description: Lease book configuration (IFRS book, local GAAP book, tax book). A book-level posting profile override supersedes the lease-level LeasePostingProfile for that specific accounting layer. Investigate this source when dual-book or multi-GAAP reporting is enabled.

Book-Level Posting Profile Override.description: Any account that could come from a book-level posting profile override

FrenchRegulatoryParameters.description: French regulatory feature parameters controlling PMA (Provision pour Mise en Amortissement). This source defines the charge account (68725) and reserve account (1510) posted alongside standard depreciation entries under French GAAP.
FrenchRegulatoryParameters.d365Path: Fixed Assets > Setup > Fixed Asset Parameters > French Regulatory Features (Tab)

PMA Provision Charge Account.description: Expense account for the periodic PMA provision charge (68725 in French PCG)

PMA Reserve Account.description: Balance sheet provision / reserve account for PMA (1510 in French PCG)

AssetGroup.description: Fixed asset group configuration. Groups can specify default accounts that override the posting profile for all assets in the group. Check when the correct posting profile is set but specific assets post to unexpected accounts.
AssetGroup.d365Path: Fixed Assets > Setup > Fixed Asset Groups

BankAccountSetup.description: Bank account configuration linking the D365 bank account record to a GL main account. The bank account used in a lease payment determines which GL account is credited for the cash outflow.
BankAccountSetup.d365Path: Cash and Bank Management > Setup > Bank Accounts

Bank Main Account.description: GL account mapped to the bank account for lease cash payments

VendorPostingProfile.description: Accounts Payable vendor posting profile — used for variable / short-term lease payments routed through AP.
VendorPostingProfile.d365Path: Accounts Payable > Setup > Vendor Posting Profiles

LedgerMapping.description: Chart of accounts main account — the fallback source. When no lease-specific posting profile source matches, the account was likely entered via a manual general journal bypassing Lease module logic.
LedgerMapping.d365Path: General Ledger > Chart of Accounts > Accounts > Main Accounts

Main Account (Direct GL).description: Direct chart of accounts reference — no module posting profile source detected
